Image generation requesting multiple images with n=3

```swift title="Swift"

let _req = try LiterLlm.createImageRequestFromJson("{\"model\":\"dall-e-3\",\"n\":3,\"prompt\":\"A cat\"}")
let result = try await LiterLlm.imageGenerate(req: _req)
debugPrint(result.data)
```
